desc: Read input $H, W$ and parse the grid rows into integers, counting the frequency of each row pattern.
Construct a cost function array $h$ of size $2^W$ where $h[x] = \min(\text{popcount}(x), W - \text{popcount}(x))$.
Implement the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT) for XOR convolution.
Apply FWHT to the frequency array and cost array, perform pointwise multiplication, and apply Inverse FWHT.
Find the minimum value in the resulting array (divided by $2^W$) and print it.
